name: sticky-section-header
title: Sticky section header
description: Section headings that stick under the page header while their section scrolls, with a hairline and solid background only when stuck.
docs: Put one header at the top of each section, as a direct child of the section: it sticks while its section is in view and the next one pushes it away. It is native position: sticky, so Page Down, find in page and screen magnifiers behave. Set offset to the height of a fixed navbar above. Sticking needs no overflow: hidden between the header and its scroll area; use overflow: clip instead. Give the scroll area a scroll-padding-top equal to the header height so focused items are never hidden behind it.
